# SlashLLM

> SlashLLM is an AI agency that goes from prompt to production. We build AI
> products, agents, and infrastructure for startups and enterprises — shipping
> working software, not slide decks.

SlashLLM offers AI strategy, AI product development, AI agent development,
production infrastructure / DevOps for AI, cost optimization, and AI-focused
branding and content. The team has shipped projects across HR tech, healthcare,
fintech, and foodtech.

- [Home](https://slashllm.com/): Overview of SlashLLM — from prompt to production.
- [Services](https://slashllm.com/services): Full service catalog — AI strategy through production infrastructure.
- [Industries](https://slashllm.com/industries): Sectors served — HR tech, healthcare, fintech, foodtech.
- [About](https://slashllm.com/about): Who SlashLLM is and how the team works.
- [Blog](https://slashllm.com/blog): Practical writing on shipping AI products, agents, and infrastructure from prompt to production.

## Articles
